scope_resolution: Authenticated caller and server-configured scope key resolve tenant, subscription, resource group, factory, project and environment. The model cannot supply scope overrides.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.purpose: Retrieve repository evidence using hybrid Search and configured semantic ranking.
tools.scope: Exact authorized active scope, enforced as a Search prefilter.
tools.retry: Embedding throttles may retry twice; semantic/Search failures surface without ranking fallback.
tools.approval: No write approval; authenticated grant required.

tools.name: knowledge_status
tools.purpose: Observe committed ingestion state, live document count and freshness.
tools.scope: Owned corpus for the active authorized deployment.

tools.name: azure_live_state
tools.purpose: Observe actual Azure resources and model deployments; installed Factory version remains unknown.
tools.scope: Exact configured subscription and resource group, never a model-selected endpoint.

tools.name: factory_health
tools.purpose: Read the real existing Factory API health.

tools.name: factory_capabilities
tools.purpose: Read the actual existing Factory creation capabilities through its SDK.
tools.scope: Configured API and active grant; capabilities do not grant authority.

tools.name: factory_catalog
tools.purpose: Read and filter the real catalog to the exact configured IDs and authorized placement.
tools.scope: Server-selected catalog folder, factory, scale set, project and placement.

tools.name: factory_settings
tools.purpose: Read the exact supported Factory configuration and source revision.
tools.scope: Same exact configured IDs, verified against the live catalog.

tools.name: factory_cli_health
tools.purpose: Actually invoke the existing azurefactory CLI health command.
tools.scope: Configured API URL, fixed Python module and validated argument array.
tools.approval: No write approval; arbitrary shell/executables are not supported.

tools.name: factory_prepare_settings
tools.purpose: Prepare a real configuration-only department metadata plan from the authenticated proposal endpoint.
tools.scope: Exact configured single DEV placement; backend validates underlying preview and revision.
tools.changes_state: Creates a pending plan/review, never confirms Factory changes.
tools.approval: Separate authenticated approval of the exact hash; execution uses Blob ETag CAS and one-use state. Destructive and infrastructure deployment operations are not exposed.
